identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS

review_prompts: Can normal launch reach any compiler package manager Git mutable download or model pull path?
Can Terraform destroy or a trap delete the persistent warm volumes?
Are timing denominators complete and comparable?
Can stale or cross-AZ volume content activate?
Are #605 SSH private-Ollama IAM and cleanup invariants preserved?

findings.summary: Destructive recovery does not bind mutable Terraform state and live state-owned resources before destroy.
Launch does not require valid aggregate preparation cost evidence and concurrent launches can race the shared ledger.
Resume terminal and incomplete paths do not bind the resource ledger campaign ID.
Recovery campaign validation does not reconcile full stored authorization and consumed-marker provenance.

residual_risk: No compute is running while the final fail-closed state and cost guards are repaired.
